name: AR Dogfight: SPADs & Fokkers
summary:
Strap in — it's 1918, and the golden age of aerial combat has invaded your living room!

**AR Dogfight: SPADs & Fokkers** turns your real space into a miniature Western Front.  Authentic WWI fighters at miniature scales bank and weave around your furniture in full mixed reality, ducking behind the sofa and screaming past the bookshelf.
